■Stage Direction
故郷＝ふるさと (Home / Hometown)
Spread the word! About the charm of this brilliant bento!!

You have to try it once! Especially the chikuzenni!
The bamboo shoots are crunchy yet soaked with flavor right to the core—a true masterpiece!

Let's see... "Love"? ...No, that's not it.
That bento is, how should I put it—a home for the soul.

As long as we properly convey how amazing your bento is, there won't be any backlash!
Instead, let's think about what to do when the orders come flooding in♪

The bento shop owner seems timid and discouraged.
He can't keep up with Seeking the Pearl's high-energy assertiveness.

Hmm... Not a single soul walks in day after day.
Taking on the world feels completely impossible to me...

First, I want the shop owner to find the courage to take a step forward.
In that case—

Seeking the Pearl's passion for this bento was hotter than I could have ever imagined.
Her burning affection seems to have sparked a grand master plan.

One single bite and you're hooked!
Mmm~~! Aaa-maaa-ziiing!!

Master's bento is a treasure chest packed with an artisan's soul and skill!
I truly believe it will move people all across the globe... with all my heart!

Expanding your target audience is the standard way to increase sales!
Simple is best!

Leave this to me!
I promise you, I will revive this shop!

Trainer... is this a bad dream?
To think this bento shop is closing down...!

All it needs is subtitles in multiple languages, and it's complete.
Let's put it on the internet and show the world! We'll make full use of social media too!
(Grumble~~)

And once name recognition goes up, the bento becomes a brand!
Breaking out of Japan and selling worldwide won't just be a dream!

I'm sorry, Pearl-chan...
I'd love to keep going if I could, but... I've hit my limit.

Let's roll out a long-term business plan right away.
First up: "Aim for Nationwide Expansion"!

...Oh? A food truck?
So many Tracen Academy students are... Wait, what's that shop name?!

A food truck—what a clever idea!
Tracen Academy is close by, so tons of students will come over!

That's right! I'm completely starving!
At this rate, I won't even be able to do my workout~!

Alright, let's do this! Our dream is global expansion!
...Just kidding!

But facing the customers directly today gave me confidence.
Just like you said, Pearl-chan, I'm going to spread the word about our bento even more from now on!

Hahaha! For someone like you, here's our special Makunouchi bento!
With perfectly balanced nutrition, your workout results will double!

Relying only on regulars leads to a mountain of waste every single day.
It just hurts too much to watch... It's about time I called it quits.
!! ...Heheh. So that's how it is.

The visions they hold might be different.
Yet deep down, the owner surely wants to revive his shop too.
Master... I had no idea you were that heartbroken...

Yeah... I was looking down so much, I lost sight of them.
The customers who leave so happy with their bento.

When our bento goes unsold every single day?
There's no way we could gain any fans...

Now, the world is waiting for this bento!
Let's move on to the next phase of our plan!
N-Nationwide...?!'

What a wonderful dream... Let's make that dream a reality!
I'll help you too!!

NOOOOOOO!
You've got to be kidding me! The shop is closing down?!

Online, you say... W-Won't we get flamed?
I hear social media can be scary... What if people attack us...?

Seeking the Pearl films a promotional video for the bento shop.
Its concept seems to be a "can't look away" infomercial style.

I'm definitely starving now!
...Oh no, I was so focused on selling that I forgot to get my own!

As he spoke, the owner slumped his shoulders in defeat.
His frustration and sorrow came through painfully clear.

One day, I came across Seeking the Pearl
screaming in front of a bento shop.

The bento I ate with Seeking the Pearl warmed my heart
and brought back fond memories of home... That's the kind of flavor it had.

This is a traditional taste that has been cherished for years, you know?!
Losing your bento would be a loss for all of Japan! Please don't say you're quitting, Master!

That's my Trainer for you!
Come on, let's go eat over on that bench! Fufufu!

...It's far too early to give up. Having few customers just means
there are plenty of people who haven't tasted this yet, right?

Oh, Pearl-chan! And Trainer-san too!
Just look, business is booming!

During a break once filming wrapped up—
I asked Seeking the Pearl once more about her feelings toward this bento.

With just one bite, it spreads across your whole palate.
A quintessential Japanese landscape I've never even seen before. Heheh, it's so mysterious.

Come on, everyone! First come, first served!
Are you really going to miss out on an exquisite bento destined for global fame?!

I'm sure Master's kindness shines through in his bento.
A taste of home that heals the fatigue of these high-strung days...
Thanks in part to Seeking the Pearl's promotion, the bento sold out completely.

Haaai, Pearl! Why the gloomy face?
Could it be that you're too hungry to exert any strength?

Let me introduce him. He's a sales strategy advisor acquainted with my father.
When I mentioned the bento, he enthusiastically agreed to help out!

If Seeking the Pearl is right, it could succeed anywhere in the world.
However, the shop owner himself has lost all his confidence...

Hey, Trainer. What's going on here?
I'm busy with the Bento Shop World-Wide Project, you know...
